scenes.en: Your eyes may be the reason.
scenes.say: Do you get a headache after hours on your laptop or phone? Your eyes may be the reason.

scenes.en: A tiny muscle inside the eye works hard to focus up close. Hours of it tire the eye.
scenes.ta: அருகில் பார்க்க கண் தசை கடினமாக உழைக்கிறது
scenes.say: To see up close, a tiny muscle inside your eye keeps working to focus. Hours of close work tire it out, and that strain can show up as a headache.

scenes.en: Studies show we blink about half as often when we stare at a screen.
scenes.say: Did you know? Studies show we blink about half as often while staring at a screen. So eyes dry out and feel heavy.

scenes.en: A small uncorrected power or old glasses make your eyes work even harder.
scenes.ta: சிறிய கண் பவர் கூட தலைவலி தரலாம்
scenes.say: A small eye power that is not corrected, or old glasses, makes your eyes work even harder.

scenes.en: Screen an arm's length away, a little below eye level. Good room light.
scenes.ta: திரை ஒரு கை தூரத்தில், கண் மட்டத்துக்கு கீழே
scenes.say: Fix your desk. Keep the screen about an arm's length away, a little below eye level, and work in good room light, not in the dark.

scenes.en: Every 20 minutes, look far away for 20 seconds. Blink fully.
scenes.say: Every twenty minutes, look far away for twenty seconds, and blink fully. Drink water too.

scenes.en: Sudden severe headache with eye pain, red eye, blurred vision or vomiting.
scenes.ta: கண் வலியுடன் கடும் தலைவலி என்றால் உடனே மருத்துவரை பாருங்கள்
scenes.say: But if a sudden severe headache comes with eye pain, a red eye, blurred vision or vomiting, see an eye specialist urgently.

scenes.en: Regular screen headaches? Start with an eye test.
scenes.say: Getting screen headaches often? Start with an eye test. Book yours today.
